translations.title: Naproxen 250 mg Soft Capsule
translations.efficacy: This medicine is used for osteoarthritis, rheumatoid arthritis and ankylosing spondylitis; tendinitis and bursitis; acute gout; painful menstruation; musculoskeletal disorders such as sprains, bruises and low back pain; pain after surgery or tooth extraction; and migraine.
translations.usage: For pain, adults first take two capsules (500 mg), then one capsule (250 mg) every 6 to 8 hours, without exceeding 1,250 mg a day. If your stomach is sensitive, take it after food, and do not take it together with other anti-inflammatory painkillers.
translations.caution: Do not take this if you have ever reacted to this medicine, aspirin or other anti-inflammatory painkillers; if you have a peptic ulcer, severe liver or kidney impairment, heart failure or bronchial asthma; for pain around coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery; if you are pregnant or breastfeeding; or if you are a child aged 2 or under. Because there is a risk of cardiovascular clots such as heart attack and stroke and of gastrointestinal bleeding or ulcers, stop taking it and seek advice if you have stomach pain, black stools, a rash or difficulty breathing.

summaryTable.Main symptoms: Menstrual pain, headache, toothache, muscle pain, joint pain, low back pain
summaryTable.Who should be careful: Stomach problems, cardiovascular or kidney disease, pregnancy
